title: subagent: Research arXiv AI regulation axes

content:

Identify the paper (arXiv ID and title) and list ALL SIX label words (two per axis).

Then: search arXiv's Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph) category for articles submitted on 11 August 2016, and determine which of those six words is used in one of those articles to describe a type of society.

Report: the paper title/ID, the six axis words, the title/ID of the Aug 11 2016 physics.soc-ph article, and the matching word. If your tools are blocked by permissions, say so clearly in your first line.
